lessons.title: Practice Assert Helpers
lessons.description: Write assert_equal(actual, expected) that raises AssertionError with a clear message on mismatch. The test checks that invalid input raises AssertionError.
learning_objectives: This step hands the reading back after the check passes, using check and 3.

tests.name: test_assert_equal
tests.unittest_code:
def test_assert_equal(self):
    assert_equal(1, 1)
    with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
        assert_equal(1, 2)

lessons.title: Practice Fixture-like Setup
lessons.description: Build with_temp_dict(factory) that creates a dict via factory, yields it to a callback, then clears it. The test checks that with_temp_dict(dict, cb) equals {}.
learning_objectives: This step shows the setup reading after teardown adjusts it, using setup and 1.
lessons.solution_code:
def with_temp_dict(factory, callback):
    data = factory()
    callback(data)
    data.clear()
    return data

lessons.title: Practice Approximate Float Compare
lessons.description: Implement approx_equal(a, b, tol=1e-6) for float comparisons in tests: two numbers count as equal when their distance is within tol. The test checks that approx_equal(0.1 + 0.2, 0.3, tol=1e-9) is true; approx_equal(1.0, 1.1, tol=1e-3) is false.
learning_objectives: This step keeps the reading when it sits close to the target, using close and 45.
lessons.solution_code:
def approx_equal(a, b, tol=1e-6):
    return abs(a - b) <= tol

tests.name: test_approx

exercises.solution_code:
def close(value, target):
    gap = value - target
    if gap < 0:
        gap = -gap
    return value if gap < 3 else value + 15
label = close(44, 45)
print(label)
